{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Extract batch A and batch B final biomarker values
batch_a = df[df['assay_batch'] == 'A']['biomarker_final']
batch_b = df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final']

# Convert batch B from µg/L to ng/mL by dividing by 10
batch_b_corrected = batch_b / 10

# Compare the distributions of batch A and corrected batch B
print(f'Batch A (ng/mL): min={batch_a.min():.1f}, max={batch_a.max():.1f}, mean={batch_a.mean():.1f}')
print(f'Batch B (corrected ng/mL): min={batch_b_corrected.min():.1f}, max={batch_b_corrected.max():.1f}, mean={batch_b_corrected.mean():.1f}')

# Check if the corrected batch B values are now in the same range as batch A
# If so, this supports the 10× conversion
max_batch_a = batch_a.max()
min_batch_b_corrected = batch_b_corrected.min()

print(f'Is min corrected batch B > max batch A? {min_batch_b_corrected > max_batch_a}')
print(f'Is max corrected batch B < min batch A? {batch_b_corrected.max() < batch_a.min()}')"}
